description: Same prompts on Apple M5: this repository's Metal engine vs MLX (mlx-lm), BF16 and MLX 4-bit. MLX: 1 warmup + 2 measured runs, prompt_tps/generation_tps from stream_generate; ours: metal-infer, 2 runs, prefill = prompt tokens / prefill_seconds, decode = decode_forward_tokens_per_second. 64 new tokens max.

versions.mlx: 0.32.2 (mlx-lm 0.32.2), Python 3.12.16 via uv, outside the repository

outputs: first 6 generated IDs equal for ours and MLX BF16 on all prompts (MLX computes activations in BF16, ours in FP32, so later tokens can differ: 454-token prompt ended after 28 vs 31 tokens). MLX 4-bit diverges from the 2nd or 3rd token on the longer prompts.
reading: decode: MLX BF16 reaches about the ~80 tok/s bound estimated from weight bytes / measured bandwidth (ADR 0009); ours is at 0.81x of MLX. Prefill (compute-bound GEMM): ours is 7-11x slower. 4-bit: decode 3.7x ours, prefill about the same as MLX BF16.
